== Hero Usage ==
* Heroes only use Shield Guardian if three or more party members in earshot are under attack.

== Notes ==
* If one party member blocks an attack, the enchantment ends only on that party member (the healing can potentially trigger for each affected party member if they block an attack).
* Healing is within earshot of the ally that blocked.

== Trivia ==
* The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[/Skill history|skill history]] for details.
